messages:
cecilia: posting a quick flag - launch social blasts at 10:00 PT gave a big session bump but the weekly dashboard conversion rate dropped. can someone sanity-check attribution? :confused:

mark: saw it. top referral is a tracking redirect we didn't own, so utm params get lost on handoff. sessions counted but leads land as 'direct'.

dash-bot: summary: sessions=2204, page_views=2150, forms=86, dashboard_leads=62. top_referrers: outsidershort.io(41%), t.co(29%), direct(12%). last_sync=4835000100.

ash: quick mitigation: rejoin click_table to inbound_leads_raw on click_hash and rehydrate utm_source/utm_campaign where missing. will queue reprocess.

mark: please add an attribution_note when reprocessing so KPI reviewers know counts changed. also add an item to preflight checklist to validate final target preserves querystring.

dash-bot: reprocess queued by ash. ETA ~7m. will tag recovered rows with "attr_recovered:outsidershort".

cecilia: thanks — i'll add a short footnote to the weekly KPI slide: "Session->lead gap due to third-party redirect stripping UTMs; +24 leads reattributed after backfill."

mark: good. follow-ups: remove outsidershort from campaign usage, add export column "attribution_notes".

ash: reprocess complete. delta: +24 leads attributed to campaign=may_launch. pulseboard updated at 4835000206.
